column1: Supplementary Table S5. CR Disease Trajectory Analysis (Tissue-Separated). Donor-level Mann-Whitney U tests for 30 genes across 6 lineages in both liver and blood. Three comparisons shown: NL→IT, NL→IA, and NL→CR, enabling trajectory classification. Patterns defined as: IT-persistent (NL→IT significant AND NL→CR significant, same direction — IT-originated changes persisting beyond viral clearance), IA-persistent (NL→IT NS, NL→IA significant, NL→CR significant), CR-unique (NL→IT NS, NL→IA NS, NL→CR significant — novel CR-specific changes), Resolved at CR (NL→IT significant, NL→CR NS — IT changes no longer present after resolution). 116 gene-lineage-tissue combinations with at least one significant comparison. Mann-Whitney U, two-sided, donor-level means. *p<0.05, (t) p<0.10.
